scope: Adjudicate the cited, third-party statement-match and axiom receipts for a dependent project. No theorem proving, mathematical acceptance on behalf of a customer, or claims of new proof checking.
acceptance: Both comparator logs must report zero process exit, a matching verified aggregate and each requested theorem once. The Lean axiom audit must list each requested theorem exactly once with the registered allowed axioms. The source snapshot must match pinned bytes. Independent direct inspection and candidate indexing must agree on all real and negative cases.
